parser_input.description: returns a pointer to raw certificate field bytes

untrusted_size.description: returns the explicit length of those bytes

length_of.description: computes string length by scanning for a NUL terminator; unsafe for length-delimited buffers

error_setter.description: printf-style function that records an error/info message; its %s format specifier requires a NUL-terminated string

allocator.description: allocates a new buffer through an out-parameter and returns its length
